ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: the figure shows a fused bicyclic skeleton, with a benzene ring on the left and a nitrogen-containing saturated six-membered heterocycle on the right; there is an N-H below the heterocycle. The saturated carbon above the heterocycle is connected to a positively charged OH2 group, and curved arrows and hydrogen-migration-related arrows are also drawn in the figure, but the problem requires ignoring these arrows. Reasoning: starting from the positively charged hydrated hydroxyl group is written as [OH2+], and it is singly bonded to an aliphatic ring carbon, denoted as C1. Along the saturated heterocycle, passing sequentially through two aliphatic carbons and one nitrogen can be written as C1CCN. Then this nitrogen is connected to the aromatic carbon of the fused benzene ring, denoted as c2, and then write ccccc along the benzene ring, using 2 and 1 to complete the closures of the aromatic ring and saturated ring. Therefore the corresponding SMILES is [OH2+]C1CCNc2ccccc21.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the atom labels and bonds in the skeletal formula, explicitly ignoring all reaction arrows. Start at the positively charged OH2 group attached to the saturated ring carbon and write it as [OH2+] attached to an aliphatic carbon. Trace around the saturated heterocycle as C1-C-C-N-c2, then continue through the fused benzene ring as ccccc and close both rings with the digits 2 and 1. The resulting SMILES is [OH2+]C1CCNc2ccccc21.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个稠合双环骨架，左侧为苯环，右侧为含氮的饱和六元杂环；杂环下方有一个 N-H。杂环上方的饱和碳连有一个带正电的 OH2 基团，图中还画有弯箭头和氢迁移相关箭头，但题目要求忽略这些箭头。推理：从带正电的水合羟基写起为 [OH2+]，它单键连接到一个脂肪族环碳，记为 C1。沿饱和杂环依次经过两个脂肪族碳和一个氮，可写作 C1CCN。随后该氮连接到稠合苯环的芳香碳，记为 c2，再沿苯环写 ccccc，并用 2 和 1 完成芳香环与饱和环的闭合。因此对应的 SMILES 是 [OH2+]C1CCNc2ccccc21。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Direct structure-to-SMILES transcription from the depicted connectivity; this is the natural single route for this image-grounded identification task.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the skeletal structure while ignoring curved arrows: a benzene ring fused to a saturated six-membered N-heterocycle; the ring nitrogen is secondary amine [NH] in the saturated ring; the benzylic/spiro-like top saturated carbon bears an OH2 substituent with a positive charge on oxygen; adjacent saturated carbons complete the fused bicyclic tetrahydroquinoline-like framework.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the prompt instruction that the required output is the SMILES expression of the shown transition-state structure and that arrows should be ignored; there are no additional textual chemical constraints.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use standard SMILES rules: aromatic fused benzene atoms are written with lowercase c, aliphatic ring atoms with uppercase C/N, ring-closure digits encode the fused bicyclic ring, and protonated water substituent attached through oxygen is written as [OH2+] when oxygen has two hydrogens and a positive charge. Convert the fused connectivity into a valid traversal such as [OH2+]C1CCNc2ccccc21.
